name: night-ski-fashion-editorial
image_purpose: Winter resort and fashion editorial social content

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic night-ski fashion portrait at a high-altitude alpine resort.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a full-coverage white thermal ski jumpsuit with black vertical piping, a high collar, white protective ski helmet, and matte black goggles resting on top. She stands calmly in a three-quarter side profile with hands gently clasped at waist level.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 editorial framing with the adult subject in sharp focus against pristine powder snow. Include panoramic snow-capped mountain ranges, a valley with warm illuminated ski runs and string lights, distant bokeh, and a dark blue starry sky. Avoid a body-part close-up or rear emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft cool moonlight on the subject balanced by warm tungsten resort lights, soft directional shadows, cinematic high dynamic range without an HDR look, refined nocturnal alpine atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion editorial, full-frame camera with 85mm f/1.8 lens, realistic fabric and skin texture, controlled depth of field, crisp powder snow, subtle natural grain, no logos or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic vertical 9:16 night-ski fashion editorial portrait of one generic approved adult woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a full-coverage white thermal ski jumpsuit with black vertical piping and high collar, white protective ski helmet with matte black goggles resting on top, standing calmly in three-quarter side profile with hands clasped gently at waist level, pristine powder snow, panoramic snow-capped mountain ranges, valley with warm illuminated ski runs and string-light bokeh, dark blue starry sky, soft cool moonlight balanced with warm resort lights, crisp realistic fabric and skin texture, refined cinematic alpine mood, no logos, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, body-part close-up, rear emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate subject, blurry, daytime, unreadable text, logos, watermark
